package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
)

const NextActionSchema = "student-next-action.v1"
const NextActionPolicyVersion = "student-next-action-policy.v1"

// NextActionSnapshot extends the existing selected-workspace read responsibility.
// It is input only: resolution never persists or executes a command.
type NextActionSnapshot struct {
	StudentID           string
	Context             StudentLearningContext
	SelectedPath        *StudentLearningPath
	LifecycleReason     string
	Bindings            []PracticeLearningActionBinding
	Answers             []NextActionAnswerState
	BindingRequirements map[string]LessonRequirement
}
type NextActionAnswerState struct {
	LearningPathItemID, RequirementID, AnswerID string
	Status                                      int
}
type NextActionTarget struct {
	AnswerID           string `json:"answer_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID     string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	CourseID           string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID           string `json:"lesson_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID      string `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID             string `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
	PracticeRevisionID string `json:"practice_revision_id,omitempty"`
	TaskInstanceID     string `json:"task_instance_id,omitempty"`
	StepID             string `json:"step_id,omitempty"`
	MilestoneID        string `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionID       string `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionScope    string `json:"submission_scope,omitempty"`
}
type NextAction struct {
	Kind   string           `json:"kind"`
	Target NextActionTarget `json:"target"`
}
type NextActionVersions struct {
	ContextVersion int64  `json:"context_version"`
	PathVersion    int64  `json:"path_version"`
	RuntimeVersion string `json:"runtime_version,omitempty"`
	StateDigest    string `json:"state_digest"`
}
type StudentNextAction struct {
	Schema           string             `json:"schema"`
	PolicyVersion    string             `json:"policy_version"`
	Status           string             `json:"status"`
	Primary          *NextAction        `json:"primary,omitempty"`
	SecondaryActions []NextAction       `json:"secondary_actions"`
	ReasonCode       string             `json:"reason_code"`
	SourceVersions   NextActionVersions `json:"source_versions"`
}

// PracticeExecutionProjection contains no Runtime state-machine enums, private
// validation payload, workspace pointer, or capability.
type PracticeExecutionProjection struct {
	Schema             string   `json:"schema"`
	StudentID          string   `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string   `json:"task_instance_id"`
	LearningActionID   string   `json:"learning_action_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string   `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string   `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	LearningPathID     string   `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string   `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID      string   `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	Status             string   `json:"status"`
	SuggestedAction    string   `json:"suggested_action,omitempty"`
	AvailableActions   []string `json:"available_actions"`
	ReasonCode         string   `json:"reason_code"`
	Version            string   `json:"version"`
	StepID             string   `json:"step_id,omitempty"`
	MilestoneID        string   `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionID       string   `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionScope    string   `json:"submission_scope,omitempty"`
}

func IsPracticeProgressionAction(kind string) bool {
	switch kind {
	case "START_PRACTICE_LEARNING", "START_PRACTICE", "RESUME_PRACTICE", "SUBMIT_PRACTICE", "REVIEW_VALIDATION_RESULT", "RETRY_PRACTICE":
		return true
	}
	return false
}
func RequiredNextActionBinding(s NextActionSnapshot, b PracticeLearningActionBinding) bool {
	if b.LifecycleStatus != PracticeLearningActionOpen && b.LifecycleStatus != PracticeLearningActionReserved {
		return false
	}
	if b.RequirementID == "" {
		return true
	}
	if requirement, ok := s.BindingRequirements[b.LearningPathItemID+":"+b.RequirementID]; ok {
		return requirement.Required && !requirement.Satisfied
	}
	if s.SelectedPath == nil || b.LearningPathID != s.SelectedPath.ID {
		return true
	}
	for _, i := range s.SelectedPath.Items {
		if i.ID != b.LearningPathItemID {
			continue
		}
		for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
			if r.ID == b.RequirementID {
				return r.Required && !r.Satisfied
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// ResolveNextAction centralizes deterministic precedence. Runtime facts are
// owner-provided bounded facts validated by the use case before this pure call.
func ResolveNextAction(s NextActionSnapshot, projections map[string]PracticeExecutionProjection) StudentNextAction {
	out := StudentNextAction{Schema: NextActionSchema, PolicyVersion: NextActionPolicyVersion, SecondaryActions: []NextAction{}, SourceVersions: NextActionVersions{ContextVersion: s.Context.Version}}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
		Snapshot NextActionSnapshot
		Runtime  map[string]PracticeExecutionProjection
	}{s, projections})
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	out.SourceVersions.StateDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	target := NextActionTarget{}
	if s.SelectedPath != nil {
		target.LearningPathID = s.SelectedPath.ID
		target.CourseID = s.SelectedPath.CourseID
		out.SourceVersions.PathVersion = s.SelectedPath.Version
	}
	decide := func(status, kind, reason string, t NextActionTarget) StudentNextAction {
		out.Status = status
		out.ReasonCode = reason
		if kind != "" {
			out.Primary = &NextAction{Kind: kind, Target: t}
		}
		if status == "READY" || status == "WAITING" {
			out.SecondaryActions = append(out.SecondaryActions, NextAction{Kind: "ASK_TEACHER", Target: t})
		}
		return out
	}
	if s.LifecycleReason != "" && s.LifecycleReason != "path_completed" {
		if s.LifecycleReason == "planning_in_progress" {
			return decide("WAITING", "", s.LifecycleReason, target)
		}
		return decide("PLANNING_REQUIRED", "", s.LifecycleReason, target)
	}
	// An already active required execution takes precedence over route selection
	// and over any lower-priority unsatisfied requirement.
	bindings := append([]PracticeLearningActionBinding(nil), s.Bindings...)
	sort.Slice(bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return bindings[i].TaskInstanceID < bindings[j].TaskInstanceID })
	required := []PracticeLearningActionBinding{}
	for _, b := range bindings {
		if RequiredNextActionBinding(s, b) {
			required = append(required, b)
		}
	}
	// Blocking executions win first; ties are stable by immutable instance ID.
	sort.SliceStable(required, func(i, j int) bool {
		pi, oki := projections[required[i].TaskInstanceID]
		pj, okj := projections[required[j].TaskInstanceID]
		return (!oki || pi.Status == "BLOCKED") && (okj && pj.Status != "BLOCKED")
	})
	answers := append([]NextActionAnswerState(nil), s.Answers...)
	sort.Slice(answers, func(i, j int) bool {
		if (answers[i].Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview) != (answers[j].Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview) {
			return answers[i].Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview
		}
		if answers[i].LearningPathItemID != answers[j].LearningPathItemID {
			return answers[i].LearningPathItemID < answers[j].LearningPathItemID
		}
		return answers[i].RequirementID < answers[j].RequirementID
	})
	officialBlocked := func() *NextActionTarget {
		if s.SelectedPath == nil {
			return nil
		}
		for _, a := range answers {
			if a.Status != StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
				continue
			}
			for _, i := range s.SelectedPath.Items {
				if i.ID != a.LearningPathItemID || i.Status == LearningPathItemCompleted || i.Status == LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
					continue
				}
				for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
					if r.ID == a.RequirementID && r.Required && !r.Satisfied {
						t := target
						t.LearningPathItemID = i.ID
						t.LessonID = i.ReferenceID
						t.RequirementID = r.ID
						t.TaskID = r.SourceReference.ID
						t.AnswerID = a.AnswerID
						return &t
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if len(required) > 0 {
		b := required[0]
		t := target
		t.LearningPathID = b.LearningPathID
		if s.SelectedPath == nil || b.LearningPathID != s.SelectedPath.ID {
			t.CourseID = ""
		}
		t.LearningPathItemID = b.LearningPathItemID
		t.RequirementID = b.RequirementID
		t.PracticeRevisionID = b.TaskRevisionID
		t.TaskInstanceID = b.TaskInstanceID
		if s.SelectedPath != nil && b.LearningPathID != "" && b.LearningPathID != s.SelectedPath.ID {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "active_activity_other_path", t)
		}
		p, ok := projections[b.TaskInstanceID]
		if !ok {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "runtime_unavailable", t)
		}
		out.SourceVersions.RuntimeVersion = p.Version
		t.StepID = p.StepID
		t.MilestoneID = p.MilestoneID
		t.SubmissionID = p.SubmissionID
		t.SubmissionScope = p.SubmissionScope
		if p.Status == "BLOCKED" {
			return decide("WAITING", "", p.ReasonCode, t)
		}
		if p.Status == "COMPLETED" {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "completion_evidence_pending", t)
		}
		if p.Status == "CANCELLED" {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "runtime_binding_reconciliation_required", t)
		}
		if p.Status != "READY" || !IsPracticeProgressionAction(p.SuggestedAction) {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "runtime_projection_invalid", t)
		}
		if pending := officialBlocked(); pending != nil {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "official_review_pending", *pending)
		}
		for _, a := range p.AvailableActions {
			if a != p.SuggestedAction && IsPracticeProgressionAction(a) {
				out.SecondaryActions = append(out.SecondaryActions, NextAction{Kind: a, Target: t})
			}
		}
		if s.SelectedPath != nil && b.LearningPathItemID != "" {
			t.LessonID = ""
			for _, i := range s.SelectedPath.Items {
				if i.ID == b.LearningPathItemID && i.ReferenceType == "lesson" {
					t.LessonID = i.ReferenceID
					out.SecondaryActions = append(out.SecondaryActions, NextAction{Kind: "REVIEW_LESSON", Target: t})
				}
			}
		}
		return decide("READY", p.SuggestedAction, p.ReasonCode, t)
	}
	if pending := officialBlocked(); pending != nil {
		return decide("WAITING", "", "official_review_pending", *pending)
	}
	if s.SelectedPath == nil {
		if s.LifecycleReason == "path_completed" {
			return decide("NO_PROGRESSION", "", "path_completed", target)
		}
		return decide("PLANNING_REQUIRED", "", "planning_required", target)
	}
	path := s.SelectedPath
	if path.Status != LearningPathStatusActive {
		return decide("NO_PROGRESSION", "", "path_inactive", target)
	}
	var item *LearningPathItem
	for n := range path.Items {
		if path.Items[n].Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
			item = &path.Items[n]
			break
		}
	}
	if item == nil {
		for n := range path.Items {
			i := &path.Items[n]
			if i.Status == LearningPathItemCompleted || i.Status == LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
				continue
			}
			if i.Status == LearningPathItemReady || i.Status == LearningPathItemPlanned {
				item = i
			}
			break
		}
	}
	if item == nil {
		return decide("NO_PROGRESSION", "", "path_items_completed", target)
	}
	target.LearningPathItemID = item.ID
	if item.ReferenceType == "practice" {
		target.PracticeRevisionID = item.ReferenceID
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
			return decide("WAITING", "", "runtime_binding_missing", target)
		}
		return decide("READY", "START_PRACTICE", "practice_not_started", target)
	}
	target.LessonID = item.ReferenceID
	// Required in-flight official Course assessment takes priority over other
	// unsatisfied requirements; Student is already this activity's runtime owner.
	for _, answer := range answers {
		if answer.LearningPathItemID != item.ID {
			continue
		}
		required := false
		quiz := false
		for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
			if r.ID == answer.RequirementID && r.Required && !r.Satisfied {
				required = true
				quiz = r.Type == "quiz_passed"
				target.TaskID = r.SourceReference.ID
			}
		}
		if !required {
			continue
		}
		if answer.Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
			target.RequirementID = answer.RequirementID
			target.AnswerID = answer.AnswerID
			return decide("WAITING", "", "official_review_pending", target)
		}
		if answer.Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress {
			target.RequirementID = answer.RequirementID
			target.AnswerID = answer.AnswerID
			kind := "CONTINUE_TASK"
			if quiz {
				kind = "TAKE_QUIZ"
			}
			return decide("READY", kind, "official_attempt_active", target)
		}
	}

	requirements := []LessonRequirement{}
	for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if r.Required && !r.Satisfied {
			requirements = append(requirements, r)
		}
	}
	priority := func(kind string) int {
		switch kind {
		case "theory_acknowledged":
			return 0
		case "quiz_passed":
			return 1
		case "task_passed":
			return 2
		default:
			return 3
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(requirements, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := priority(requirements[i].Type), priority(requirements[j].Type)
		if a != b {
			return a < b
		}
		return requirements[i].ID < requirements[j].ID
	})
	if len(requirements) > 0 {
		r := requirements[0]
		target.RequirementID = r.ID
		for _, answer := range answers {
			if answer.LearningPathItemID == item.ID && answer.RequirementID == r.ID {
				target.AnswerID = answer.AnswerID
				if answer.Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed || answer.Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected {
					target.TaskID = r.SourceReference.ID
					return decide("READY", "RETRY_TASK", "official_attempt_failed", target)
				}
				if answer.Status == StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
					return decide("WAITING", "", "completion_evidence_pending", target)
				}
			}
		}
		switch r.Type {
		case "theory_acknowledged":
			if item.Status != LearningPathItemInProgress {
				return decide("READY", "START_LESSON", "theory_required", target)
			}
			return decide("READY", "CONTINUE_LESSON", "theory_required", target)
		case "quiz_passed":
			target.TaskID = r.SourceReference.ID
			return decide("READY", "TAKE_QUIZ", "quiz_required", target)
		case "task_passed":
			target.TaskID = r.SourceReference.ID
			return decide("READY", "START_TASK", "task_required", target)
		case "practice_completed":
			target.PracticeRevisionID = r.SourceReference.ID
			return decide("READY", "START_PRACTICE", "practice_required", target)
		}
	}
	if len(item.FrozenRequirements) > 0 {
		return decide("WAITING", "", "lesson_completion_pending", target)
	}
	if item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
		return decide("READY", "CONTINUE_LESSON", "lesson_active", target)
	}
	return decide("READY", "START_LESSON", "lesson_ready", target)
}
